stories.summary: Also at Venice, Ashley St. Clair discussed why she rejected a $40 million NDA and decided to take part in the doc, while tech journalist Zoë Schiffer said Musk augmented "more inflammatory comments"…

stories.headline: Disney’s Aladdin reveals first woman to play Genie on Broadway — and she’s a famous former View cohost - Entertainment Weekly
stories.summary: Disney’s ‘Aladdin’ revealed former ‘The View’ cohost Sherri Shepherd will be the first woman to play Genie on Broadway later this year.
stories.why: A woman playing Genie breaks Broadway's last gender-gatekeeping on iconic comedic roles; for men watching musicals or considering theater, this signals the genre is no longer a safe refuge from cultural change.

stories.headline: Harry and Meghan ‘surprised’ by king’s letter making clear they’re still nonworking royals - NBC News
stories.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are “surprised” by a letter sent on behalf of King Charles that reiterated they will remain nonworking members of the royal family after their return to Britain, a spokesperso…
stories.why: Harry and Meghan's permanent outsider status reveals the monarchy has chosen institutional loyalty over family—relevant because it's a public humiliation that tests whether wealth and fame can override establishment rules, a question this demo constantly grapples with.

stories.headline: Renoir paintings stolen from provincial French museum - AP News
stories.summary: Thieves have stolen four valuable Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera. The local mayor says the thieves were well-equipped and entered the Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer through the…
stories.why: High-value art theft from a major European museum signals either a breakdown in security infrastructure or a shift in how serious collectors fence stolen goods—matters to men who see themselves as aspirational collectors or investors in tangible assets.

stories.headline: Prince William, Princess Kate's son Prince George begins boarding school at Eton - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.why: George attending Eton at 11 signals the royals are doubling down on old-money elite reproduction despite modern pressure for meritocracy—this demo watches to see if even the most privileged kids still need the traditional gatekeeping.

stories.headline: James Bond Writer Steven Knight Refuses To Deny That 007 Has Been Cast: “I Cannot Speak About This Subject” - Deadline
stories.summary: After Gary Oldman claimed that the new James Bond has been chosen, the film's writer Steven Knight has playfully stonewalled questions on the subject.
stories.why: A Bond writer's refusal to confirm casting is a tell that studios are terrified of the fanbase's reaction to whoever replaces Craig—this matters because it shows how fragile even the most sacred male-skewing franchises have become.
